title: Number of 1 Bits
summary: Return the number of 1 bits in the 32-bit binary representation of n.

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 2147483647. Treat the bit pattern as an unsigned 32-bit word.

statement: Return the number of 1 bits in the 32-bit binary representation of n.

examples.explanation: A power of two has one set bit.

constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 2147483647. Treat the bit pattern as an unsigned 32-bit word.
hints: Directional: Subtracting one changes the lowest set bit and the zeros below it.
Implementation: Repeatedly AND the word with the word minus one and count how many iterations clear it.
complexityAnalysis: O(w) worst-case time and O(1) space, with w=32.
